name: shipwithai
description: ShipWithAI SDLC Toolkit — Claude Code plugins covering the full software development lifecycle.

plugins.name: shipwithai-auth
plugins.description: Set up production-ready auth in minutes. Supports Better Auth and Firebase Auth with OAuth social login, UI components, database schemas. Auto-detects existing themes.

plugins.name: shipwithai-design-toolkit
plugins.description: Governance harness for the ShipWithAI design system: spec-first workflow skills, read-only auditor agents (incl. design-harness-doctor), and warn-only guardrail hooks. Install one plugin and a dev/agent inherits the whole workflow.

plugins.name: shipwithai-harness
plugins.description: Generate a production-ready Claude Code harness for your project. Auto-detects stack (Next.js, Laravel, Spring Boot). Generates CLAUDE.md, settings.json, and safety hooks in one command.

plugins.name: shipwithai-java-backend-toolkit
plugins.description: Guardrail-first Spring Boot + JPA toolkit. Just-in-time hooks catch missing @Version, broken @Transactional proxies, entity-in-controller leaks, N+1, and query injection as you write them; scaffold skills generate correct-by-default entities, endpoints, and migrations; a tuned reviewer agent shares one ruleset with the hooks.

plugins.name: shipwithai-knowledge-toolkit
plugins.description: Governance harness for the ShipWithAI knowledge corpus: a thin orchestration layer that runs the existing citation/outcome validators, links the member handbook, and prepares governance dossiers for a human to sign.

plugins.name: shipwithai-mobile-ui-harness
plugins.description: Self-improving Compose Multiplatform UI harness. Inspection tests render every screen across a stress matrix; a deterministic Tier-1 asserter plus a vision evaluator grade them in a separate lane; recurring findings ratchet into permanent gates via a compounding feedback ledger. Ships Konsist architecture rails and a setup skill that scaffolds it all into a project.

plugins.name: shipwithai-starter
plugins.description: Set up a standardized Claude Code harness for any project. One guided interview configures CLAUDE.md, permissions, hooks, MCP servers, agents, and SSOT docs. Three tiers: Essential (5 min), Standard (15 min), Full (30 min).
